name: Winter
note: The field gets quiet; the notebook does not.
activities: Review the previous season's batches and field notes
Plan garden space, seeds, tools, labels, and experiments
Work with stored or dried materials where appropriate
Make room for family time and necessary rest

name: Spring
note: The first useful window may be brief.
activities: Watch new growth rather than forcing a calendar date
Gather only correctly identified material from places where it is allowed
Clean workspaces and prepare drying, infusing, and fermentation equipment

name: Summer
note: Long light compresses a great deal of work into each week.
activities: Tend garden plants and observe flowering stages
Harvest selected leaves, flowers, fruit, or shoots as their use requires
Sort, clean, dry, infuse, ferment, and test small batches
Photograph products and share current releases through Square and Facebook

name: Autumn
note: Finishing one cycle begins the notes for the next.
activities: Finish drying and process shelf-stable ingredients through validated methods
Blend, package, and compare seasonal work
Save observations about weather, timing, flavor, and what to change next year
